_om: Panna in English (Forehead, rusj.no/en/forehead/). Key = the Norwegian text in spill.js. The decks are in data.en/kortstokker.json, written for the UK; the Norwegian word bank is not used outside Norway. Shared words come from rusj/kit/tekst.en.json.
Check the label at the top of each card.
The others give clues – without saying the word.
Panna tok seg en pause. Neste gang!: The forehead took a breather. Next time!
Trykkmodus – vipping er skrudd av i opps: Tap mode – tilting is turned off in the settings
Mobilen spør om bevegelse – trykk «Tilla: The phone will ask about motion – tap ‘Allow’.
Vipping ble ikke tillatt – en av de andr: Tilting wasn't allowed – one of the others taps instead.
Fant ingen bevegelsessensor – en av de a: No motion sensor found – one of the others taps instead.
The screen should face the others.
Én holder mobilen mot panna og ser ikke: One person holds the phone to their forehead and can't see the word. The others give clues – and you guess as many words as you can before time runs out.
Snu mobilen på tvers og hold den mot pan: Turn the phone sideways and hold it to your forehead with the screen facing the others.
De forklarer, mimer og lager lyder – men: They explain, act and make noises – but never say the word itself.
Vipp ned når du har gjettet riktig, og o: Tilt down when you've guessed it, and up to pass.
Uten vipping: La en av de andre trykke –: Without tilting: let one of the others tap – the right side is got it, the left is pass.
Skjermen blinker grønt for riktig og ora: The screen flashes green for got it and orange for pass, so the others can see the answer was counted – even with the sound off.
I «Mim det!», «Lag lyden!» og «Si det so: In ‘Act it out!’, ‘Make the noise!’ and ‘Say it like …’ the others give clues in one particular way. The label at the top of the card says which.
Spill med én kortstokk om gangen for å s: Play one deck at a time to collect stars and beat the record.
Etter runden kan dere trykke på et ord f: After the round you can tap a word to fix a mistake.
På iPhone må du tillate bevegelse første: On an iPhone you have to allow motion the first time. Tap ‘Allow’ when the phone asks.
Skal bare de minste spille? Velg kortsto: Only the little ones playing? Choose the ‘Kids’ deck.
Phone on your forehead. The others give clues.
Vipp ned når du har det!: Tilt down when you've got it!
Flere ord fra ordbanken: More words from the word bank
Spill med én kortstokk for å samle stjer: Play one deck alone to collect stars:
Middels tar med lette og middels ord. Va: Medium includes easy and medium words. Hard includes everything.
Ned er riktig, opp er pass. Trykk på skj: Down is got it, up is pass. Tapping the screen always works.
Ta tur med mobilen og se hvem som gjette: Take turns with the phone and see who guesses the most.
Turn it sideways, screen facing out.
The right side is got it, the left is pass.
Gi mobilen til den som skal gjette: Pass the phone to whoever is guessing
The words you've got so far still count.
Trykk på et ord for å rette: Tap a word to correct it
{n} ord gjettet til sammen. Beste runde:: {n} words guessed in all. Best round: {navn} with {riktige} right.
{hvem} got {hva} in {n} s in {spill}. Can you get more?
Choose one or more. The scores are kept.
Dere går rett til kåringen og ser hvem s: You'll go straight to the results and see who won.
You can always start a new one.
